sn55.18:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva jetavane antarahito devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
sn55.18:1.3: atha kho sambahulā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatāyo yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā devatāyo āyasmā mahāmoggallāno etadavoca
sn55.18:2.1: sādhu kho āvuso buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti
sn55.18:2.2: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.18:2.3: buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho āvuso evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
sn55.18:2.6: sādhu kho āvuso ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṃ hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.18:2.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanahetu kho āvuso evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
